item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00070","case1_error":"Counts the three workers twice, multiplying their combined $150 earnings by three again.","case2_error":"Uses only the overtime premium as extra-day pay, omitting that day's $8 base wage.","reason":"The first duplicates an already included factor; the second omits a required pay component.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00071","case1_error":"Writes correct group products, then supplies inconsistent intermediate numbers and an unsupported extra summand, producing 112 instead of 40.","case2_error":"Models the count with 2x + (26 − 8 − 3) = 26 instead of x + 8 − 3 = 26.","reason":"The first corrupts the numerical aggregation after correct group formulas; the second explicitly constructs an erroneous counting relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00072","case1_error":"Treats the ordinary selling price as construction cost, then subtracts the extra construction expense twice.","case2_error":"Invents replacement purchases, equates total sales with refunds, and reports the refund amount instead of retained sales.","reason":"The first misidentifies construction cost and repeats an expense deduction; the second conflates refunds with sales and returns the wrong quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00073","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 21, but the derivation correctly obtains 29 yellow marbles.","case2_error":"Adds the senior discount back after correctly subtracting it, undoing the discount.","reason":"The first contains only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared or different mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00074","case1_error":"Adds the two parent lambs again although they are already included in the original six.","case2_error":"Miscounts adults and treats 12 eggs per basket as 12 eggs per person, ignoring the 15 baskets.","reason":"The first double-counts an existing subset. The second also miscounts people, but its result comes from substituting a per-person allocation for basket capacity.","judgment":"different"}]}
